articles.summary: Curbline Properties Corp. (NYSE: CURB), an owner of convenience centers in suburban, high household income communities, announced today an update on fourth quarter and full year 2026 investment activity. “Investment activity remains elevated, consistent with our commentary provided in Curbline’s third quarter earnings release, as the Company continues to scale the fragmented yet highly liquid convenience market. We continue to see a growing pipeline of actionable investment opportunities consist
articles.title: Curbline Properties Announces Fourth Quarter 2026 Investment Update
